item.title: Essex County to consider relief from green bin fees
item.description: Essex County will consider providing some relief from green bin charges over the next few years. At Wednesday’s council meeting, Lakeshore Mayor Tracey Bailey introduced a notice of motion — meaning it will likely be debated at the next meeting — to fund the fees from reserves and the general tax levy.
